Resolves #19707

`DockFlip.land()` now restores captured geometry with CSS transitions suppressed, flushes the restored state, then reinstates the caller's transition policy. This stops an active transform transition and prevents a new one when landing interrupts the inverse frame, so native resize reads the landed geometry. Exact inline presentation and unrelated animations are preserved.

The nested-column witness reaches the real Mouse distance threshold and records the actual `Resize.start` boundary. Its original width, topology, identity, release and Escape checks remain intact.

Evidence: L3 real-browser and native pointer journeys, plus source-bound Linux A/B, achieved; L3 required by this leaf. Broader ten-shard rollout remains owned by #19657.

Change class: restoration. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the shared baseline jobs carry PR-body and substrate-size checks.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside-CI browser controls in `WorkstationNestedColumnResizeNL.spec.mjs`: pending inverse and playing transition, pre-existing nonzero transition policy, exact inline restoration and an unrelated animation. Linux baseline fails both; repaired source passes. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI trusted pointer journey records fixed staging immediately before Main `landFromPath` and clean computed geometry at the real `Resize.start`. The second drop's real motion outlives the unchanged test deadline; a measured ≥400 ms latency fault precedes admission. Omitting landing remains red. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI complete existing nested-column journey, including original tolerances and release/Escape oracles, passes locally and on Linux. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered `DockFlip.spec.mjs` and existing Main admission lifecycle/order controls; the fixture now supplies the browser animation-state API. |
| AC-5 | Source-bound [Linux A/B receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38336528493) at `18ce1340`: baseline DockFlip blob `ade7134d49905d2b102ff4b64906fb46b491b09e` fails 9/9, repaired blob `cc0f3f23b006283601e0b49b2c32d0d5ed3f540d` passes 9/9. The quarantine exit proof was handed to #19705's owner; wider rollout remains #19657. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The controlled witness removes the Mouse sensor's delay while preserving its real distance threshold and trusted pointer path. It restores the borrowed sensor setting and instrumentation after each test. The temporary Linux probe workflow was removed. The original source-bound Linux proof predates the review's fixture-only motion-window refinement and the one-line flush rationale; that refinement has current-candidate native evidence below.

## Test Evidence

- [Linux A/B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38336528493): the same three-case file repeated three times, retries zero, on one runner. Baseline 9 failures; repaired source 9 passes in 40.8s. Baseline resize observes residual computed transforms despite cleared inline styles and fixed-stage classes.
- Local native complete file: 9/9 in 28.5s, without retry or skip. The no-op-landing negative control fails at actual native admission, even if the landing result is forged as successful.
- After review repair: the complete native file passes 9/9 in 27.7s with the ≥400 ms latency fault. Current dev integration `527c3a6a89` passes all three cases in 10.8s. The original duration token returns at native landing before resize release and on failure cleanup.
- The pending-inverse control also rejects restoring a nonzero caller transition policy before restoring geometry; the final cleanup order passes both pending and playing cases.
